text:
lina: Heads-up: starting a staggered region rollout for redwood-v2.1.2 in ~20m. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary slices 3% by default, 10m pin after canary.

dave: I'll run preflight capacity + queue checks and post results.

infra-oncall: Running GPU headroom and warm-pool status now. Threshold = 60% free GPUs to go full canary.

jamal: Quick note: v2.1.2 includes kv cache gating + slight tokenization tweak. Watch `p95_latency`, `kv_cache_miss_rate`, and `500_rate`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release=redwood-v2.1.2 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.03 pin=10m. Use `/deploy status 1739993210`.

infra-oncall: Preflight outputs:
```
US: free GPUs 95/120 (79%), queue depth low
EU: free GPUs 52/80 (65%), queue depth low
APAC: free GPUs 24/48 (50%), queue depth moderate
```
APAC < threshold. Recommend warming APAC or lowering canary there.

paula: Can we warm APAC by +3 warm nodes? That should bring us to ~66% free.

infra-oncall: Triggering warmpool +3 in APAC. ETA ~5m. If still <65% after warmup we'll switch APAC canary to 1% and hold full rollout.

lina: Plan: start US canary now. If US is green, EU next. APAC conditional.

deploy-bot: Prechecks: US pass, EU pass, APAC fail (50% free GPUs).

deploy-bot: Starting US canary (slice s-201).

jamal: Observing US slice. p95 +8ms, 500_rate 0.02% (normal), kv_cache_miss_rate stable.

dave: US metrics stable during 10m pin. Proceed to EU. `/deploy start --release redwood-v2.1.2 --region eu --canary 0.03 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: EU canary started (s-202).

infra-oncall: APAC warm-pool completed: new free GPUs 30/51 (59%). Still below 60.

paula: APAC still tight. Suggest APAC canary 1% and monitor for 15m before any wider ramp.

lina: Agreed. Update: `/deploy update 1739993210 --region apac --canary 0.01 --pin 15m`

deploy-bot: APAC canary config updated. Starting APAC canary (s-203) at 1%.

deploy-bot: :warning: APAC canary s-203 shows `kv_cache_miss_rate` spike at +3m (peak 1.2%).

jamal: Logs indicate errors on host pool apac-rt-7: `ShardMismatchException` in kv router.

paula: Initiating immediate rollback for s-203. `/deploy rollback --slice s-203 --reason "kv router shard mismatch"`

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for s-203. APAC pin released.

infra-oncall: Isolating apac-rt-7 and running config sync. Applying patch to KV router and will redeploy for smoke test in staging.

dave: EU rolled fine. US rolled fine. APAC failed canary; holding rollout. Opening incident INC-2026-147 with triage notes and links.

lina: Thanks all. Action items: 1) infra-oncall to finish patch + staging smoketest, 2) jamal to prepare rollback writeup and checks for next attempt, 3) paula to coordinate warmpool sizing for next window. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases once staging test passes.

deploy-bot: Deployment thread closed by lina. For follow-ups use INC-2026-147 and link back to this thread.
